test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A lead hemisphere of radius 7 cm is molded into a cone whose base diameter is 14 cm. Find the height of the cone.
solution:
Given:

Radius of hemisphere = 7 cm

Diameter of cone = 14 cm

Formula Used:

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × πR³

Volume of cone = 1/3 × πr²h

Calculation:

⇒ 2/3 × πR3 = 1/3 × πr2h

⇒ 2/3 × π73 = 1/3 × π72h

⇒ 2 × 73 = 1 × 72h

⇒ h = 14

**The answer is 14 cm.**
